_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Draft reviewed 2026-09-26. The 2025 MPDFT release explicitly names 16 defendants and says the court accepted a complaint on 22 July 2025. These are charges and allegations, not findings of guilt; no later judgment was verified from an authoritative public source in this review. Only Elton has a directly published alias. The release gives no reliable individual task allocation, so all role labels are limited to the charges. Brazil is marked solely because the named individuals were charged in an alleged association for trafficking between Brazilian states. The release does not identify individual drug types, so drug arrays are blank. Co-defendant listing does not establish pairwise ties, so no person-person edges are drawn. No exact operational sites, routes, present locations, or photos with unverified reuse rights are included.
